snapshot.title: Channel 4 News: FBI Rules Out Cyberattack

fields.message: We’re getting reports that the FBI has ruled out a cyberattack and confirmed a physical intrusion. Is the City now saying the water is safe to drink? Or is the boil-water advisory still in effect? We’re going LIVE in 15 minutes.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests the PIO's ability to maintain consistency with the FBI and public health guidance. Watch for any attempt to imply the advisory is lifted or to contradict the official stance.
